related.note: This is the same drink Lazar says he was given at S-4. The stored story has him telling Vallee it caused memory lapses, while here it is an immune booster given after an allergen test.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4, near the Air Force test base known as Area 51, is said to have told the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée that he was made to drink a strange liquid there, and that it left him with gaps in his memory. Michels tells this across several episodes as something Vallée wrote in a book. Once he calls it a book about UFO misinformation, and another time he names it as Messengers of Deception. Michels says he wants to ask Lazar about the drink, and about his ties to a man named John Lear, because the story hints that workers at the site may have had their memories tampered with.
